rules.mean_ce: Current Q5/Q6 rule: minimum mean validation CE across four source-validation folds.
rules.median_ce: Minimum median validation CE across folds.
rules.trimmed_mean_ce: At each epoch remove highest and lowest fold CE and average the middle values.
rules.worst_fold_ce: Minimize the largest validation CE across folds (minimax).
rules.mean_rank: Rank epochs separately within each fold and minimize mean rank.
rules.median_rank: Rank epochs separately within each fold and minimize median rank.

interpretation_boundary: These are retrospective source-only sensitivity analyses. A future rule must be frozen before new target evaluation. Target BA must not be used to select among these rules.
